mapper.select: INSERT INTO time_mentions (id, kb_id, fact_id, chunk_id, text, char_start, role) VALUES (#{id}, #{kbId}, #{factId}, #{chunkId}, #{text}, #{charStart}, #{role}) ON CONFLICT (fact_id, chunk_id, char_start, role) DO UPDATE SET text = time_mentions.text RETURNING id

SELECT id, fact_id, chunk_id, text, char_start, role, shape, reference, granularity, grade, resolved_from, resolved_from_precision, resolved_to, resolved_to_precision FROM time_mentions WHERE fact_id = ANY(#{factIds,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[]) ORDER BY fact_id, chunk_id, char_start, role

SELECT m.id, m.fact_id, m.chunk_id, m.text, m.char_start, m.role, COALESCE(fe.quote, c.text) AS sentence FROM time_mentions m JOIN chunks c ON c.id = m.chunk_id JOIN facts f ON f.id = m.fact_id LEFT JOIN fact_evidence fe ON fe.fact_id = m.fact_id AND fe.chunk_id = m.chunk_id WHERE c.document_id = #{documentId} AND c.superseded_at IS NULL AND f.layer = 'open' AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.seq, m.char_start, m.role
mapper.update: UPDATE time_mentions SET shape = #{shape}, reference = #{reference,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.JsonNodeTypeHandler}, granularity = #{granularity} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE time_mentions SET grade = #{grade}, resolved_from = #{from}, resolved_from_precision = #{fromPrecision}, resolved_to = #{to}, resolved_to_precision = #{toPrecision}, resolved_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
